items.question: You will receive a ------- e-mail from the Nicoya Hotel verifying your travel plans within two hours of making your reservation.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“confirmation”代入题干后为“You will receive a confirmation e-mail from the Nicoya Hotel verifying your travel plans within two hours of making your reservation.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：B（confirmation）。
